name: Audio Processing Consumer
summary: Consumes bounded audio representations and portable processing outputs across supported runtime targets.
description: Uses generic audio decoding, PCM transformation, and windowing capabilities with explicit format, rate, channel, and resource constraints. Does not own microphone access, capture scheduling, a location catalog, species policy, model selection, or a user interface.

distinguished_from.how: Consumes signal-processing outputs without selecting, licensing, or releasing a classifier model.
Consumes portable signal-processing outputs rather than preparing evidence bundles for a human review decision.
